title: openai-compat: implement tool_choice semantics + schema mapping and preserve tool message formatting (streaming fixes)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's OpenAI-compat tool/function calling path to parity with OpenAI semantics for tool_choice while preserving our internal tool schema mapping and streaming stability. This PR implements tool_choice resolution that prefers explicit tool_choice fields when provided by the model, falls back to best-effort schema matching when tool_choice is omitted, and ensures we forward the assistant->tool messages without losing formatting or metadata. It also fixes a streaming edge case where partial tokens from tool responses could be emitted out of order when combined with our newline trimming logic. Key changes: 1) tool_choice semantics implementation in the compat layer; 2) schema mapper that translates OpenAI-style tool schemas into internal ToolDescriptor objects and vice-versa; 3) preserve original role/content and all message metadata when forwarding tool messages to user-facing channels; 4) streaming handler fixes to buffer partial UTF-8 tokens and respect tool message boundaries; 5) tests and docs updates. Checklist: - [x] Implement tool_choice resolution and fallback mapping - [x] Add end-to-end tests for assistant->tool->assistant roundtrip - [x] Fix streaming buffering and add regression tests - [x] Update compatibility docs and examples - [x] Run perf and CI and resolve flakes Testing notes: added unit tests for schema mapping and integration tests that simulate models returning tool_choice for ambiguous tool names; run e2e streaming tests with a randomized partial-token injector to validate no reordering; manual smoke tested in dedicated staging with Canary routing. Risk: medium — changes live in compat layer only and we added comprehensive tests; streaming fix touches runtime path so monitoring dashboard was extended to track tool-calling stream errors. Migration: none required for customers but internal SDKs relying on previous ambiguous behavior may see different resolved tool when models return tool_choice explicitly. See release_notes for more details.
commits: Add tool_choice resolution and fallback mapping
Introduce schema mapper: OpenAI schema -> ToolDescriptor
